scope: ROOT001–040 original batch functions descriptions, explicit members and distinctions, plus eight actually read reused pilot function/prestate/effect records. No trajectory regenerated, no Stage resegmented, no old case or registry modified.
definition_basis: PEER_FINAL_FUNCTION_DEFINITIONS_AUTHORED.json, unchanged. These eight neutral functional families are comparison proposals, not eight mechanism labels or mandatory exclusive classes.
method: Codex read all ROOT batch function records before writing ROOT_FINAL_FUNCTION_SELECTORS_AUTHORED.tsv. Mixed-source membership was decided individually with explicit case exceptions. Targeted existing case function/prestate/effect rereads resolved the listed conflicts; no keyword-generated assignments.
index_convention: function_index zero-based. ROOT_PILOT index0 points to each actual current adjudication /function with pilot provenance, not to a mechanism file. ALL applies only to the named source batch function's already-explicit members.

pilot_scope: Eight ROOT-owned pilots are explicitly selected using actual /function records. PEER-owned twelve pilots remain only in unchanged PEER grouping source. No pilot is duplicated as a new reviewed case.
peer_addendum: WORK_NOTES/PEER_FUNCTION_724_RELATION_CHECK_ADDENDUM_AUTHORED.json is explicitly approved as an additional secondary PF_OPEN_RELATION_CHECK membership in the new combined member table, not a modification of original PEER files.
limits: These are original-U function families, not NEW mechanism findings or restoration labels.
Within-family stage-specific P, operation, product and source distinction remain visible; no claim that all retrieval has equal information value.
Multiple function memberships overlap; Stage, question, original run and four associated rollout counts are deduplicated separately and cannot be summed across families.
Associated rollouts do not mean four functions were reconstructed, four mechanism occurrences, or four causal tests without G.
ROOT can accept/refine these explicit groupings during final review; they are not researcher gold or an automatic merge by equal names.
